flashcard_questions.q: A gradual decline in moral character, principles, or integrity, especially in those who hold power.
A statement that contains two contradictory ideas, creating an apparent absurdity that reveals a deeper truth.
Prolonged cruel or unjust treatment or control, especially by those in power.

flashcard_questions.a: A complete turn, meaning a return to the starting point. Orwell uses this literal meaning to show that the revolution has come full circle.
A story, poem, or picture that can be interpreted to reveal a hidden meaning, typically a moral or political one.
